description: Registers services and checks for an agent with a Consul cluster. A service is some process running on the agent node that should be advertised by Consul’s discovery mechanism. It may optionally supply a check definition, a periodic service test to notify the Consul cluster of service’s health.

parameters.name: check_host
parameters.description: Host name.

parameters.name: check_id
parameters.description: An ID for the service check. If state=absent, defaults to check_name. Ignored if part of a service definition.

parameters.name: check_name
parameters.description: Name for the service check. Required if standalone, ignored if part of service definition.

parameters.name: check_node
parameters.description: Node name.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Host of the Consul agent defaults to localhost. Default: "localhost"

parameters.name: http
parameters.description: Checks can be registered with an HTTP endpoint. This means that Consul checks that the http endpoint returns a successful HTTP status. Requires interval to be provided. Mutually exclusive with script, ttl and tcp.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: The interval at which the service check is run. This is a number with a s or m suffix to signify the units of seconds or minutes, for example 15s or 1m. If no suffix is supplied s is used by default, for example 10 is 10s. Required if one of the parameters script, http, or tcp is specified.

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Notes to attach to check when registering it.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port on which the Consul agent is running. Default: 8500

parameters.name: scheme
parameters.description: The protocol scheme on which the Consul agent is running. Default: "http"

parameters.name: script
parameters.description: The script/command that is run periodically to check the health of the service. Requires interval to be provided. Mutually exclusive with ttl, tcp and http.

parameters.name: service_address
parameters.description: The address to advertise that the service is listening on. This value is passed as the address parameter to Consul’s /v1/agent/service/register API method, so refer to the Consul API documentation for further details.

parameters.name: service_id
parameters.description: The ID for the service, must be unique per node. If state=absent, defaults to the service name if supplied.

parameters.name: service_name
parameters.description: Unique name for the service on a node, must be unique per node, required if registering a service. May be omitted if registering a node level check.

parameters.name: service_port
parameters.description: The port on which the service is listening. Can optionally be supplied for registration of a service, that is if service_name or service_id is set.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Register or deregister the Consul service, defaults to present. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Tags that are attached to the service registration.

parameters.name: tcp
parameters.description: Checks can be registered with a TCP port. This means that Consul checks if the connection attempt to that port is successful (that is, the port is currently accepting connections). The format is host:port, for example localhost:80. Requires interval to be provided. Mutually exclusive with script, ttl and http.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: A custom HTTP check timeout. The Consul default is 10 seconds. Similar to the interval this is a number with a s or m suffix to signify the units of seconds or minutes, for example 15s or 1m. If no suffix is supplied s is used by default, for example 10 is equivalent to 10s.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token key identifying an ACL rule set. May be required to register services.

parameters.name: ttl
parameters.description: Checks can be registered with a TTL instead of a script and interval this means that the service checks in with the agent before the TTL expires. If it does not the check is considered failed. Required if registering a check and the script an interval are missing Similar to the interval this is a number with a s or m suffix to signify the units of seconds or minutes, for example 15s or 1m. If no suffix is supplied s is used by default, for example 10 is equivalent to 10s. Mutually exclusive with script, tcp and http.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate of the Consul agent. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Register nginx service with the local Consul agent
  community.general.consul:
    service_name: nginx
    service_port: 80

- name: Register nginx service with curl check
  community.general.consul:
    service_name: nginx
    service_port: 80
    script: curl http://localhost
    interval: 60s

- name: register nginx with a tcp check
  community.general.consul:
    service_name: nginx
    service_port: 80
    interval: 60s
    tcp: localhost:80

- name: Register nginx with an http check
  community.general.consul:
    service_name: nginx
    service_port: 80
    interval: 60s
    http: http://localhost:80/status

- name: Register external service nginx available at 10.1.5.23
  community.general.consul:
    service_name: nginx
    service_port: 80
    service_address: 10.1.5.23

- name: Register nginx with some service tags
  community.general.consul:
    service_name: nginx
    service_port: 80
    tags:
      - prod
      - webservers

- name: Remove nginx service
  community.general.consul:
    service_name: nginx
    state: absent

- name: Register celery worker service
  community.general.consul:
    service_name: celery-worker
    tags:
      - prod
      - worker

- name: Create a node level check to test disk usage
  community.general.consul:
    check_name: Disk usage
    check_id: disk_usage
    script: /opt/disk_usage.py
    interval: 5m

- name: Register an http check against a service that's already registered
  community.general.consul:
    check_name: nginx-check2
    check_id: nginx-check2
    service_id: nginx
    interval: 60s
    http: http://localhost:80/morestatus
